北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 30℃，记得多喝水防暑哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy with a feels-like 30℃. Remember to drink water to prevent heatstroke!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波大雨，体感 32℃，出门记得带伞，注意出行安全。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has heavy rain with a feels-like 32℃. Remember your umbrella and travel safely.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 33℃，体感闷热，记得清爽出行哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast with a feels-like 33℃. It feels muggy, so dress lightly!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 36℃，炎热持续，请多补水防晒，注意休息。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels like 36℃, heat continues. Stay hydrated, sun-protected, and rest well.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天体感 33℃，有些闷热，穿衣清爽些更好。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast with a feels-like 33℃. It's a bit muggy, so dress cool.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨，湿度 93%，出门记得带伞，小心路滑！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain and 93% humidity. Remember your umbrella and watch for slippery roads!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，能见度低，驾车出行请减速慢行，注意安全。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy with low visibility. Drive slowly and carefully, stay safe.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感 36℃，天气炎热，请多喝水，避免长时间户外活动。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels like 36℃, hot weather. Drink plenty of water and avoid long outdoor activities.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云体感 31℃，湿度较高，注意防暑和身体舒适。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy with a feels-like 31℃ and high humidity. Stay cool and comfortable.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 35℃，天气闷热，多补水，保持清爽很重要。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels like 35℃, muggy weather. Hydrate well and stay cool.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆体感 37℃，高温来袭，请务必防晒防暑，多休息。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing feels like 37℃. High temperatures, be sure to prevent sunstroke and rest well.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，风力 4级，体感舒适，户外活动注意防风。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with a force 4 wind. Feels comfortable, but protect yourself from wind outdoors.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳大雨，风力 4级，出门备好雨具，注意添衣保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has heavy rain and force 4 wind. Prepare rain gear and dress warmly.
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降12℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感舒适，户外活动很不错，但别忘防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with a comfortable feel. Great for outdoors, but don't forget sun protection.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感 31℃，湿度大，请注意除湿，保持干爽。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast with a feels-like 31℃ and high humidity. Pay attention to dehumidification and stay dry.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，风力 4级，体感舒适，海边活动注意防晒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy with a force 4 wind and feels comfortable. Enjoy the beach, but protect from sun.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 29℃，风力 3级，海风宜人，注意防晒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with a feels-like 29℃ and force 3 wind. Enjoy the sea breeze, but remember sun protection.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天体感 32℃，天气闷热，多喝水，注意防暑。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is overcast with a feels-like 32℃, muggy weather. Drink water and prevent heatstroke.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雨，湿度 100%，出门带伞，注意防潮！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has heavy rain and 100% humidity. Take an umbrella and watch out for dampness!
